title: Zesty Roasted Indian Piccalilli Rasam
description: A roasted, fluffy, and cozy Indian dish featuring piccalilli, this rasam is a macrobiotic-friendly delight. It combines the flavors of India with the tanginess of piccalilli.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the piccalilli in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a large pot, heat the ghee or oil over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato, rasam powder, and salt to the pot and stir well.
Add the roasted piccalilli, split red lentils, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the rasam to the desired consistency.
Serve the rasam hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions.
